raw.title: Engineering Manager, Commercial Systems
raw.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets.
raw.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager, who strives for accountability for the development of an internal product, who has high engineering quality standards, continuously develops their skills as well as skills of their direct reports, and who has the drive to deliver. This is an exciting opportunity to work with great people and exciting open-source solutions on innovative engineering solutions supporting Canonical's growth.

The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as six engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business. We are looking for software engineering managers for these teams:

The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business, payment systems. This team is an excellent match for those interested in growing their skills in the billing and payment processing domain.

The Business Systems team is responsible for systems such as NetSuite, Salesforce, and several others. The engineers work closely with operations teams, implement business processes, and keep the systems compliant. This team is a great opportunity for a software engineering leader with a genuine interest in understanding the business, high engineering standards, and drive to deliver first-class experience to Canonical employees using those systems to get their job done.

The Data Governance team has a mission to enable a secure and well-governed access to comprehensive data sets originating at many internal and external data sources formed in a data mesh. The team works with well-known open-source data governance tools such as Trino and Ranger, defines and executes data governance processes, and democratizes the data at Canonical.

The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for those interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Accountability for the design and development of an internal product
  • Leading a team of software engineers
  • Developing the skills and capabilities of direct reports
  • Seeking improvements to established processes, designs, and solutions
  • Building an understanding of business needs to deliver the most impact

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Experience with software development in a high-level language (Golang, Python, Java, ...)
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Performance engineering and SRE experience
  • Experience with data governance, data engineering, or data science
  • Experience with accounting, sales, sales operations, or other business roles

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

raw.description:
About Engine

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, one of the fastest-growing companies in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you're a senior voice on Engine's central infrastructure team — the group that owns the substrate every product team at Engine ships on top of. Your work is horizontal by default: the patterns you design, the modules you ship, and the paved roads you maintain are used across every business vertical.

You'll be hands-on with:

  • Cloud infrastructure — the AWS accounts, networking, deployment patterns, and operational tooling that Engine's product teams depend on day to day.
  • Terraform — designing and evolving the shared module registry that feature teams across the company consume.
  • CI/CD — pipeline templates and GitHub Actions workflows that set the standard for how code ships at Engine.
  • Reliability & observability — Datadog dashboards, SLO frameworks, and incident response tooling used org-wide.
  • Security & networking — Cloudflare configuration, IAM boundaries, and secret management as platform-level primitives.
  • Cost visibility — building the tooling and reporting that helps every team understand and act on what they own and spend.

You'll partner closely with feature teams across verticals — not by embedding with them, but by running a tight feedback loop: understanding their friction, prioritizing what deserves a paved road, and shipping platform capabilities that make the right path the easy path.

What You'll Do

  • Set the technical direction for a major area of Engine's infrastructure over a multi-quarter horizon — where it's headed, what you're deliberately not building, and how platform investments compound rather than fragment.
  • Lead multiple infra initiatives in parallel, coordinating across the central team and with the feature teams who'll adopt what you build.
  • Design and ship the Terraform modules, pipeline patterns, and operational tooling that product teams adopt because they're better than the alternative — not because they're mandated.
  • Separate signal from noise across the feature-team requests that land on the central team. Decide what deserves a paved road, what belongs in team-owned space, and what shouldn't be built at all.
  • Own the boring-but-critical work: incident response, on-call quality, deployment reliability, vendor integration health.
  • Shape the guidelines, tools, and methods every engineer at Engine uses — and coach the feature engineers who apply them.
  • Represent the infra team in cross-functional conversations with product and engineering leadership. Our team meets twice a week — that's where you'll share what's shipping, align on priorities, and pressure-test decisions.
  • Reduce the SDLC step-function count across Engine. Every approval gate, every "ask infra first" workflow is a tax — your job is to lower it.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 6+ years building and operating production cloud infrastructure, with deep AWS expertise (multi-account, networking, IAM, security boundaries).
  • Expert-level Terraform — you've designed reusable modules and have opinions about state, drift, and execution patterns.
  • Strong CI/CD background — GitHub Actions, reusable workflows, OIDC, secret management.
  • A track record of shipping platform infrastructure that feature teams actually adopt — you know how to build for internal customers without losing sight of what makes something feel like a product.
  • A bias toward enabling teams over gatekeeping. You'd rather build the paved road than approve the off-road permits.
  • Experience leading technical direction across multiple teams — making the trade-offs precisely, communicating them clearly, and bringing other engineers along.
  • Instinct for when a problem deserves a central solution and when it should stay with the team that hit it.

Strongly preferred

  • Cloudflare (WAF, DNS, zero-trust/WARP) at production scale.
  • Datadog, JFrog, or comparable vendor integration experience.
  • Background in cost observability or FinOps tooling.
  • History of working on a platform team that serves internal customers — you understand the difference between running a platform and running a gate.

Applications for this role will be accepted through 11/1/2026 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$135,150—$187,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

The Executive Order on Advancing Racial Equity and Support for Underserved Communities Through the Federal Government, issued on January 20, 2021, aims to address systemic barriers and promote equal opportunity for underserved communities and individuals in the United States. The order emphasizes the importance of advancing equity, civil rights, racial justice, and equal opportunity across all federal agencies. It directs agencies to assess their programs and policies for perpetuating systemic barriers and develop strategies to deliver resources and benefits equitably to all. The order also establishes an interagency working group to gather and analyze data to inform efforts to measure and advance equity. Additionally, it revokes previous executive orders that were seen as hindering progress in this area.

We aspire to build and enhance an exceptional and diverse team of high-achievers who always put mission and the spirit of service first. This position aligns with functional/technical service requirements and client engagements in the Client Industry Sector - : . Environmental Equity Environmental Scientist (EJE4) Candidates shall work to support requirements for RFQ1645224 | 89603023Q0075 Environmental Equity Functional Area Services and shall work as a Environmental Equity Environmental Scientist (EJE4).

Review and Analyze Environmental Assessment Documents: Conduct comprehensive reviews and analysis of environmental assessment documents to identify potential impacts on environmental justice communities. This will include evaluating policies, practices, and methodologies used by federal, state, and local agencies to determine geographic scope and reach for infrastructure projects.

  • Presentations and Briefings: Deliver presentations of findings and conclusions to FERC stakeholders, as well as optional staff briefings as needed.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.


Department Overview

Motorola Solutions is the leading software developer and solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. The Emergency Call Handling solution team is one business sleeve of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness.

Présentation du Département

Motorola Solutions est le leader dans le développement de logiciels et la fourniture de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence. Ces logiciels permettent aux centres 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres de réception des appels de sécurité publique (Public Safety Answering Points) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. L'équipe de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence constitue une branche clé de la division Software Enterprise de Motorola Solutions, où des innovations sont développées pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, au dispatch des intervenants, et à la surveillance situationnelle.


Job Description

As a software developer, you will be joining a team developing a next generation 911 call handling solution that complies with industry standards and market demands, is capable of being deployed as a service or on-premises and meets high availability requirements our users have come to expect of 911 services. The team will utilize development talent across multiple design centers using Agile scrum methodology.

Responsibilities:

Analyzes, develops, designs, and maintains software for the organization’s products and systems.

Performs system integration of software and hardware to maintain throughput and program consistency.

Develops, validates, and tests: structures and user documentation.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of professional software development.

  • Good knowledge of JAVA and its development ecosystem.

  • Hands-on experience with web application development (Angular, Javascript)

  • Software Development: understanding of object-oriented coding and design, design patterns

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Experience developing cloud-based applications

  • Experience developing REST-based APIs and implementing microservice principles and architectures

  • Experience with modern Source control and DevOps tooling (including Git, Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines)

  • Familiarity with the concepts involved in designing a high availability architecture

  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring

  • Familiarity with unit and automated testing

  • Creativity and persistence when solving complex problems

  • Enthusiasm for learning new technologies, architectures, processes, and best practices.

Nice-to-have requirements:

  • Knowledge of at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) Practical knowledge of one or more of these technologies (at least on a basic level): Spring Boot, Angular, Terraform, Kubernetes

  • Understanding of Agile Scrum Experience and working in a CI/CD environment (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery)

  • Able to troubleshoot and debug issues on basic networking, knowledge of Wireshark

  • Knowledge of best practices and IT operations in an always up, always-available service environment.

  • Knowledge of application layer protocols, including SIP, RTP, HTTP, SOAP/REST, DNS, SMTP, SNMP, SSH, TLS, WebRTC.

  • Familiarity with tools for systems management, operational support, and performance monitoring.

  • Familiarity with modern development operations tooling (Trace based application performance monitoring, docker containers, and similar)

  • Proficiency in scripting in general (Python an asset)

Responsabilités:

En tant que développeur de logiciels, vous rejoindrez une équipe travaillant sur une solution de gestion des appels 911 de nouvelle génération. Cette solution respecte les normes de l'industrie et les exigences du marché, peut être déployée en tant que service ou sur site, et répond aux exigences de haute disponibilité attendues des services 911. L'équipe utilise des talents de développement répartis dans plusieurs centres de conception, en appliquant la méthodologie Agile Scrum.

Description du poste

Analyse, développe, conçoit et maintient les logiciels des produits et systèmes de l'organisation. Effectue l'intégration des systèmes logiciels et matériels pour assurer un débit et une cohérence des programmes. Développe, valide et teste : structures et documentation utilisateur.

  • Diplôme de licence (Bachelor) en Informatique, Génie logiciel ou Génie informatique.

  • 4+ ans d'expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel.

  • Bonne connaissance de JAVA et de son écosystème de développement.

  • Expérience pratique en développement d'applications web (Angular, Javascript).

  • Connaissance du développement orienté objet, des design patterns et de la conception logicielle.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication.

  • Expérience dans le développement d'applications basées sur le cloud.

  • Expérience dans le développement d'API REST et la mise en œuvre de principes et architectures microservices.

  • Maîtrise des outils de contrôle de version et de DevOps modernes (Git, workflows Git, pipelines CI/CD).

  • Familiarité avec les concepts d'architecture haute disponibilité.

  • Connaissance des outils de monitoring et d'observation.

  • Familiarité avec les tests unitaires et automatisés.

  • Créativité et persévérance dans la résolution de problèmes complexes.

  • Enthousiasme pour l'apprentissage de nouvelles technologies, architectures, processus et bonnes pratiques.

Exigences supplémentaires (atouts)

  • Connaissance d'au moins une plateforme cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Connaissance pratique (même de base) de certaines technologies : Spring Boot, Angular, Terraform, Kubernetes.

  • Compréhension de la méthodologie Agile Scrum et expérience dans un environnement CI/CD.

  • Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes de réseau de base (connaissance de Wireshark).

  • Connaissance des meilleures pratiques et des opérations IT dans un environnement de service toujours disponible.

  • Connaissance des protocoles applicatifs, tels que SIP, RTP, HTTP, SOAP/REST, DNS, SMTP, SNMP, SSH, TLS, WebRTC.

  • Familiarité avec les outils de gestion des systèmes, de support opérationnel, et de surveillance des performances.

  • Expérience avec des outils modernes de développement et d'exploitation (surveillance des performances des applications basées sur les traces, conteneurs Docker, etc.).

  • Maîtrise des scripts en général (la maîtrise de Python est un atout).

Target Base Salary Range: $90,000 - $ $110,000 CAD.

Why You'll Love This Role:

As part of a regional sales team and the face of Newsela in the market, the Strategic Account Executive builds relationships with key decision makers at the district level and sells Newsela’s suite of products to bring engaging learning content to school districts in the region. This role offers the opportunity to meet in-person with school and district leaders, presenting solutions, negotiating terms, and securing agreements that bring Newsela into classrooms.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Employ solution-based selling techniques and solution mapping, along with strong negotiation and closing skills, to ensure school board preparation and approval.
  • Create and maintain an aggressive pipeline, and build and adjust strategic account plans for key accounts to move each through the sales cycle.
  • Handle day-to-day responsibilities spanning everything from pipeline creation, pipeline management, and forecasting to designing lead generation campaigns and managing sales through the entire lifecycle while collaborating closely with other departments.
  • Have direct, regular exposure to our executive leadership team during meetings to discuss specific deal strategies, introduce industry trends, and build support for district-specific initiatives.
  • Work with a highly skilled team dedicated to supporting you and your book of business, alongside extensive support from our Learning & Enablement team.
  • Achieve revenue targets while collaborating with an enthusiastic, cross-functional team to catapult Newsela’s growth as we scale our national sales organization.
  • Thrive in a role that requires significant autonomy, representing the company in the market, making recommendations that impact strategy and results, and managing priorities independently.
  • Stay well-versed in the territory’s funding, state initiatives, demographics, and K-12 education landscape to help inform the overall sales strategy.
  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance, including evaluating customer needs, structuring tailored solutions, negotiating within established guidelines, and influencing revenue and business outcomes.

About You:

  • Proven Account Executive with 2+ years of demonstrated success selling supplemental products to school districts in the K12 market required.
  • Willing to build your own book of business and have extensive experience in networking, prospecting, and building a pipeline.
  • Well-versed in MEDDPICC sales methodology.
  • Proven success forecasting business in the EdTech industry.
  • Excited about the opportunity to connect face-to-face as this position involves regular travel to meet with customers and prospects.
  • Experiencing using AI tools to drive greater efficiency and productivity.
  • Legally authorized to work in the US.

This role is classified as an exempt salaried role and is not eligible for overtime.

All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check as part of our pre-employment process.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $30/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. You will receive images of business slides relating to HR, learning, and organizational development, then reconstruct and enhance them in Microsoft PowerPoint. A critical part of this opportunity is articulating both the improvements you make and the original choices you intentionally preserve, providing a thoughtful log for each task.   6. Handle diverse materials such as organization design decks, training modules, and compensation reviews.
  7. Deliver each assignment within an anticipated 1–2 hours, with volume varying by project sprint.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 3+ years of proven expertise in HR, learning & development, organizational development, or workforce strategy.
  2. Demonstrated experience crafting executive-ready PowerPoint presentations for senior stakeholders or clients.
  3. Strong skills in slide reconstruction, data visualization, visual storytelling, and business communication.

  5. Ability to clearly explain message hierarchy, evidence-supported titles, and design choices.
  6. Comfort working independently in a project-based, sprint-driven context with variable volume.

raw.description:
The Sr Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that a product or feature is developed with a focus on delivering value to the customer and the business. They act as a voice for the customer and are responsible for making key product-related decisions throughout the development process, including identifying opportunities to incorporate emerging technologies, such as AI-enabled capabilities, where they can improve user experience, workflow efficiency, and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Vision & Stakeholder Alignment

Translation: Work with stakeholders to translate future vision and requirements into clearly broken-down epics and stories; ensure all team members understand and align with product goals, including consideration of emerging technologies where appropriate.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary point of contact between the development team and stakeholders; communicate progress, changes, and updates regularly.
  • Team Enabler: Work with one or more Agile Development Teams and act as a central reference and information source, guiding system/product functionality decisions.
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: Demonstrate a track record of delivering results in fast-moving, demanding environments.

Backlog Ownership & Prioritization

  • Prioritization: Create and maintain the product backlog; prioritize features, user stories, and tasks based on business value, customer needs, market trends, and strategic opportunities.
  • Backlog Management: Continuously groom and refine the backlog based on feedback, changing priorities, and new insights.
  • Feedback Integration: Gather and incorporate feedback from stakeholders and end-users into the backlog; adjust as necessary.

Requirements & Customer Experience (UX)

  • User Story Development: Break down high-level requirements into detailed, implementable user stories that meet strong Agile standards and support effective workflows, automation, and decision support where applicable.
  • Acceptance Criteria: Define clear acceptance criteria so the team understands what constitutes “done” for each feature.
  • UI/UX Alignment: Partner with UX to ensure backlog items have wireframes and UI designs ready for sprint planning; provide design feedback, participate in design sprints, and support user acceptance testing.

Planning, Delivery & Risk

  • Sprint Planning: Participate in sprint planning to select stories and tasks; ensure the team has a clear understanding of work scope.
  • Release Planning: Collaborate with the team and stakeholders to plan and prioritize releases aligned with market needs and business goals.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure the product meets quality standards by accepting or rejecting work during sprint reviews.
  • Risk Management: Identify and mitigate delivery risks; partner with the release manager on timelines, tough conversations, mitigation strategies, and transparent escalation to leadership.

Business Outcomes & Data

  • Business Case Support: Assist in developing and presenting business cases for new features and initiatives; ensure alignment with strategic goals and stakeholder expectations.
  • Data-Driven: Define KPIs and measures for features and capabilities to track impact and inform decisions.

Required Qualifications:

Education & Experience Guidelines

  • Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
  • 4-7 years of relevant work experience
  • Experience with Product and Development tools such as ADO, Jira or other similar tools.
  • Healthcare and technical expertise are highly preferred, including experience with data, API integrations, and interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, evaluate outcomes, and assess opportunities related to emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, where applicable.
  • Leadership and decision-making skills
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities
  • Understanding of the industry, market trends, and customer needs
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, UI/UX, Product Management, leadership, and internal and external stakeholders.
  • Travel up to 30%

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Provation

Provation is a leading provider of healthcare software and SaaS solutions for clinical productivity, care coordination, quality reporting, and billing. Our purpose is to empower providers to deliver quality healthcare for all. Provation’s comprehensive portfolio spans the entire patient encounter, from pre-procedure through post-procedure, with solutions for physician and nursing documentation (Provation® MD, Provation® Apex, MD-Reports, Provation® endoPRO®, and Provation® MultiCaregiver), anesthesia documentation (#1 Best in KLAS Provation® iPro), patient engagement, surgical care coordination, quality reporting, and billing capture (Provation® SurgicalValet™), order set and care plan management (Provation® Order Set Advisor™ and Provation® Care Plans), and EHR embedded clinical documentation (Provation® Clinic Note). Provation has a loyal customer base, serving more than 5,000 hospitals, surgery centers, and medical offices, and 700 physician groups globally, including 19 of the top 20 U.S. hospitals. In 2021, Provation was acquired by Fortive Corporation, a Fortune 1000 company that builds essential technology and accelerates transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, engineering, and healthcare. For more information about our solutions, visit provationmedical.com and follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Our purpose at Provation is to empower providers to deliver quality healthcare for all. To deliver on this commitment, we’re guided by our core values – Provation has a culture of CARES:Community - We have a shared sense of improving healthcare, enriching the broader world we live in and serve. Accountability - We own it and get it done with integrity. Respect - We build diverse teams that collaborate and communicate with positive intent and trust. Excellence - We welcome new ideas as we innovate quality solutions. Service - We are passionate about putting customers first.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer – BMaaS & Datacenter Networking
raw.excerpt: About the TeamOur engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments.
raw.description:
About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Core Responsibilities

  • Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

  • Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

  • Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

  • Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

  • Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

Technical Qualifications

  • Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go.

  • Data & APIs: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, gRPC/Protobuf contract design, and schema evolution.

  • Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.

  • Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).

  • DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).

  • High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.

  • Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).

  • Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus.

  • Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation.

  • Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware).

  • Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices.

  • Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC.

  • Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM.

  • Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

Universal Requirements

  • Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external hardware and network dependencies.

  • Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews.

Educational & Experience Baseline

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-native platforms, systems programming, networking, or infrastructure automation.

  • Demonstrated participation or maintainership in open-source systems projects is a plus.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
  • Professional development and training;
  • Attend conferences and working groups;
  • Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
  • Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

raw.title: Cloud Windows Server / IIS System Administrator
raw.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesPeraton's Department of Interior (DOI) CHS III program is leading the way for Cloud Hosting and Applications Modernization across DOI and its subordinate bureaus.
raw.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton's Department of Interior (DOI) CHS III program is leading the way for Cloud Hosting and Applications Modernization across DOI and its subordinate bureaus. CHS III is facilitating the migration of legacy on-premises applications to a modern, secure and scalable multi-cloud platform. From sensors in active volcanic regions to earthquake detection data, CHS III is DOI's central cloud processing and data solution.

Peraton is seeking an experienced Windows Server / IIS Administrator to join our team supporting a federal cloud hosting and enterprise architecture program for a major U.S. civilian agency. In this fully remote role, you will be responsible for the administration, maintenance, and security hardening of Microsoft Windows Server infrastructure and Internet Information Services (IIS) web environments that support mission-critical data and application delivery operations. You will work alongside a collaborative DevOps and cloud engineering team, contributing to a secure, high-availability cloud ecosystem built on AWS. This is an excellent opportunity for a systems administration professional who wants to make a real impact supporting Federal science and data programs from anywhere in the country.

Work Location: Remote

Day To Day Roles and Responsibilities

  • Administer, patch, and maintain Microsoft Windows Server environments (2016, 2019, and newer versions) within an AWS-hosted Federal cloud infrastructure
  • Configure, manage, and optimize Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) web servers, including application pools, bindings, SSL/TLS certificates, and site-level configurations
  • Apply security hardening measures in accordance with Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), NIST SP 800-53 controls, and agency-specific security policies
  • Monitor Windows Server and IIS health, performance, and availability using enterprise observability tools (DataDog); triage and resolve incidents in alignment with defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) tiers
  • Coordinate with the DevOps engineering team on Windows-related infrastructure activities, including CI/CD pipeline integration, infrastructure-as-code (IaC) support, and automated deployment workflows
  • Support FISMA compliance activities, including vulnerability management, Information Assurance Vulnerability Alert (IAVA) remediation, and preparation of security documentation and audit artifacts
  • Respond to critical infrastructure incidents within established SLA response windows (12-hour acknowledgment for Critical/High-tier issues); participate in on-call rotation as needed
  • Maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and system documentation to support knowledge transfer and operational continuity
  • Contribute to planned maintenance window coordination, communicating impacts and scheduling downtime in advance with program leadership and Government stakeholders
  • Support onboarding and environment preparation activities to maintain Day 1 operational readiness at task order start

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree and 10 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 8 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 12 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 14 years’ professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments (2016, 2019+) in a production setting
  • 3+ years of experience managing Microsoft IIS web servers, including application pool management, site configuration, SSL/TLS administration, and performance tuning
  • Demonstrated experience applying security configurations and STIGs to Windows Server environments in Federal or regulated environments
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53 security controls and FISMA compliance requirements
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog, SolarWinds, Splunk, or equivalent) for server health and availability monitoring
  • Working knowledge of AWS cloud services relevant to Windows workloads (e.g., EC2, Systems Manager, S3, CloudWatch)
  • Proficiency with PowerShell scripting for administration, automation, and configuration management tasks
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to document procedures clearly and communicate status to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator (strongly preferred)
  • Experience in Federal civilian agency IT environments (DOI, USGS, or similar agency a plus)
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation
  • Experience integrating Windows Server patching and compliance into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions)
  • Knowledge of AWS Managed Services and hybrid cloud architectures combining on-premises Windows infrastructure with AWS-hosted workloads
  • Exposure to Agile project management environments (Jira, sprint-based workflows)
  • AWS Certified Security Specialty, CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Server+, or equivalent security certification
  • Prior experience supporting or contributing to ATO (Authority to Operate) package development or C&A activities
  • Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility requirements for web content served through IIS

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Power your future with Qualus as a Senior Project Manager on our Engineering team. This role also involves cross-disciplinary coordination, client relationship management, and mentoring junior staff. Occasional travel, including overnight stays, is required.

Responsibilities

  • The Senior Project Manager will lead and manage complex engineering projects across substation design, transmission, telecommunications, renewable energy interconnections, electric utilities and large load industrial facilities.

  • Assist clients with competitive bidding processes for steel structures, long lead electrical equipment and substation construction activities.
  • Mentor less experienced staff on a wide range of technical and project management best practices and competencies.
  • Participate in internal process improvements and help to develop Qualus's project control systems and standards.
  • Work with large load developers, renewable energy developers and other clients with support specific to schedules and cost estimates.

  • Generally, keep management appraised of project status and report as needed to clients, agencies, and team members. This often includes facilitating monthly or bi-weekly team meetings and issuing meeting notes
  • Occasional travel (1–2 times per month) with overnight stays required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • The Senior Project Manager is expected to bring an advanced level to knowledge of everything involved to complete a project design from start to finish.
  • Ideal candidates will have a Bachelor of Science (BS) Degree in Engineering, Electrical or Civil Engineering is preferred.
  • Minimum of 7–10 years of experience in utility-scale electrical projects, including substation and transmission design or related technical area.
  • Strong understanding of electrical power systems, utility interconnection requirements, renewable energy, and large load industrial infrastructure.
  • Strong competence in applying theories and principals involved in project management
  • Strong work ethic, common sense approach, and high attention to detail.
  • Customer-focused with the ability to work under pressure and manage shifting priorities.
  • Excellent computer skills, Microsoft Office, and proficient with scheduling (MS Project or Primavera P6 preferred)

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and demands

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

raw.description:
About IP House

At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property—both online and offline—on a truly global scale. Through cutting-edge technology and deep cross-border expertise, we deliver scalable, end-to-end solutions for IP portfolio management, enforcement, and content and brand protection.

With over 700 experts operating across five continents, we are trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands to combat counterfeiting, piracy, and IP infringement at scale. From digital platforms to physical marketplaces, we help clients safeguard what matters most—everywhere it matters.

Overview of the Role:

We’re looking for a Client Success Lead to own a portfolio of US and global accounts across entertainment, retail, and other sectors, and to grow it.

This is a commercial, quota-carrying role. You’ll carry an annual target built from three things: net-new business you win in your territory, expansion revenue you generate inside the accounts you hold, and the retention of that book. If you want a defined book of accounts, a market to go after, and the autonomy to build both, read on.

What makes it different is what you’re selling. IP House protects some of the world’s most recognizable brands from counterfeiting, piracy, and IP infringement. The work is technical, the buying cycle is consultative, and the clients stay for years when the delivery is good. You’ll be close enough to that delivery to sell it credibly and to grow it once it’s live.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Grow the accounts you hold. Identify expansion paths, lead the commercial conversations, and negotiate scope changes, uplifts, and renewals directly.
  • Win new business. Own the net-new logo target for your territory. Build and work your own pipeline through outbound, referrals, and industry networking, supported by marketing-generated demand. Run opportunities end to end, from first conversation through solution design, pricing, and close.
  • Keep clients. Serve as the senior relationship owner across your portfolio, run MBRs and QBRs that evidence real value, and spot retention risk long before it reaches a renewal date.
  • Work close to delivery. Partner with Operations to hold the line on timelines, quality, and compliance, and feed what you hear from clients back into Product and Client Solutions.
  • Represent IP House. Attend and speak at sector conferences and industry events as a business development presence.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 4–6 years in a quota-carrying role: sales, business development, or commercially accountable client success or account management.
  • A track record of hitting an individual revenue target
  • Experience originating and closing net-new business, not only growing accounts you inherited.
  • Comfort owning pricing conversations, negotiating terms, and closing contracts.
  • Strong retention performance across a managed portfolio.
  • Disciplined pipeline and forecasting habits, and fluency with CRM.
  • Credibility with both commercial and operational audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Sector background in IP enforcement, brand protection, legal services, SaaS, or professional services is an advantage, but we’re more interested in commercial track record and the ability to learn a complex domain quickly.

Why IP House:

IP House helps brands, legal professionals, and rights holders manage and protect intellectual property online and offline, worldwide. We combine technology with deep domain expertise to deliver IP portfolio management, enforcement, and brand protection at scale.

With over 800 experts across five continents, we’re trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands to combat counterfeiting, piracy, and IP infringement.

Why Join:

You’ll have a defined market and the autonomy to build it, in a company that is scaling and where commercial performance is visible. We offer a flexible, remote-first working environment and a comprehensive benefits package covering health, well-being, and financial security for employees and their families.

IP House is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering a respectful, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.

raw.title: Business Project Senior Advisor, Individual Dental Operations - Cigna Healthcare
raw.excerpt: Position Summary The Business Project Senior Advisor leads complex business projects and operational initiatives across Individual Dental Operations.
raw.description:
Position Summary

The Business Project Senior Advisor leads complex business projects and operational initiatives across Individual Dental Operations. This role is responsible for translating strategic priorities and business needs into structured project plans, coordinating execution across business, technology, vendor, and enterprise partners, and ensuring operational requirements are successfully implemented.

The Business Project Senior Advisor manages assigned initiatives from planning through implementation and stabilization. The role establishes project structure, clarifies scope and requirements, coordinates operational readiness, manages risks and dependencies, and provides transparent reporting to business leaders and stakeholders.

This position serves as a trusted project management advisor and senior individual contributor, supporting initiatives involving operational transformation, vendor implementation, customer experience, process improvement, regulatory change, and new or enhanced business capabilities.

Core Accountabilities and Responsibilities

Business Project and Program Leadership

  • Lead complex, cross-functional business projects from initial planning through execution, implementation, and operational stabilization.
  • Translate business objectives into defined project scope, deliverables, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans that provide clear visibility into activities, timing, ownership, and implementation readiness.
  • Coordinate execution across Operations, Technology, Product, Compliance, Finance, Vendor Management, Customer Experience, and other enterprise partners.
  • Maintain focus on intended business outcomes while adapting project plans to changing priorities, requirements, and operational conditions.
  • Provide structured leadership for initiatives that do not require a dedicated enterprise program-management resource but require disciplined business execution.

Project Planning, Governance, and Execution

  • Establish project governance practices appropriate to the size, complexity, risk, and strategic importance of each assigned initiative.
  • Facilitate project meetings, working sessions, decision forums, status reviews, and implementation-readiness discussions.
  • Maintain project documentation, including plans, status reports, action items, decisions, risks, issues, dependencies, and supporting business artifacts.
  • Monitor progress against established milestones and proactively identify conditions that may affect timing, scope, quality, cost, or operational readiness.
  • Coordinate resolution of cross-functional issues and escalate matters requiring leadership direction or decisions.
  • Ensure project participants understand their responsibilities, deliverables, deadlines, and interdependencies.
  • Support post-implementation reviews to assess outcomes, capture lessons learned, and identify remaining stabilization needs.

Business Requirements and Operational Readiness

  • Partner with business owners and subject matter experts to identify, document, validate, and communicate business and operational requirements.
  • Help translate complex business needs into clear requirements that can be understood and acted upon by Technology, Product, vendor, and operational teams.
  • Coordinate operational-readiness activities involving procedures, training, communications, testing, controls, reporting, customer support, and implementation planning.
  • Confirm that operational impacts and readiness needs are identified early and incorporated into project plans.
  • Support the development of implementation, transition, contingency, and stabilization plans.
  • Coordinate with accountable business owners to confirm that required processes, resources, documentation, and support models are prepared for implementation.
  • Identify gaps between proposed solutions and operational needs and facilitate decisions regarding remediation or risk acceptance.

Vendor Implementation and Operational Coordination

  • Lead or support business projects involving vendor onboarding, transitions, new capabilities, service changes, and operational improvements.
  • Coordinate activities among internal business teams, vendor partners, Procurement, Technology, Finance, Compliance, and other responsible functions.
  • Incorporate vendor deliverables, dependencies, contractual milestones, and operational-readiness requirements into project plans.
  • Partner with Vendor Management and business owners to identify implementation risks, unresolved requirements, and potential service impacts.
  • Facilitate alignment between vendor-provided solutions and Individual Dental operational requirements.
  • Support vendor-related testing, training, documentation, communication, implementation, and stabilization activities.
  • Provide transparent reporting on vendor project progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions requiring attention.

Risk, Issue, Dependency, and Decision Management

  • Establish and maintain clear processes for identifying, documenting, evaluating, escalating, and monitoring project risks and issues.
  • Track project dependencies and evaluate how delays or changes in one workstream may affect other deliverables or operational outcomes.
  • Facilitate timely resolution of issues by clarifying ownership, required actions, target dates, and escalation paths.
  • Prepare decision materials that clearly present the business question, relevant facts, alternatives, risks, dependencies, and operational considerations.
  • Maintain project decision records that document approved direction and resulting impacts.
  • Escalate material risks, unresolved issues, scope conflicts, and missed commitments to the appropriate project sponsor or governance body.
  • Distinguish confirmed project information from estimates, assumptions, and items requiring validation.

Stakeholder Communication and Executive Reporting

  • Develop concise, accurate, and audience-appropriate project communications for business leaders, project teams, vendors, and enterprise partners.
  • Provide regular reporting on project health, delivery progress, upcoming milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Translate detailed project information into clear leadership summaries that focus on business impact and required action.
  • Facilitate alignment among stakeholders with different priorities, responsibilities, and levels of technical or operational knowledge.
  • Establish communication approaches that promote transparency, accountability, and timely decision-making.
  • Maintain effective working relationships across organizational boundaries and influence outcomes without relying on direct authority.
  • Ensure material scope, schedule, requirement, or implementation changes are communicated to affected stakeholders.

Change Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Incorporate change-management principles into project planning and implementation activities.
  • Assess how proposed changes will affect employees, customers, business partners, workflows, tools, and operating procedures.
  • Coordinate with business leaders, Training, Communications, and operational teams to support adoption of new processes or capabilities.
  • Develop or support stakeholder assessments, communication plans, readiness activities, and transition approaches.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project delivery practices, business workflows, governance, documentation, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Apply lessons learned from completed initiatives to strengthen future planning and execution.
  • Promote disciplined but practical project-management practices appropriate to the needs of a developing Individual Dental organization.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Healthcare Administration, Operations, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Advanced experience leading complex business projects, operational initiatives, implementations, or organizational change efforts.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects involving multiple business functions, stakeholders, dependencies, and competing priorities.
  • Experience developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, status reporting, risk and issue documentation, decision records, and implementation-readiness materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into clear requirements, deliverables, responsibilities, and execution plans.
  • Experience coordinating business, operational, technology, and vendor stakeholders through implementation and stabilization.
  • Strong understanding of business project management, operational readiness, risk management, change management, and process improvement.
  • Strong facilitation, organization, problem-solving, and decision-support skills.
  • Ability to identify emerging risks, evaluate potential business impacts, and escalate concerns appropriately.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare executive-ready project updates and decision materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and establish accountability without direct reporting authority.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex initiatives and adjust priorities in a changing business environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and project-planning, collaboration, or reporting tools.

Preferred

  • Project Management Professional, Prosci Change Management, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, or comparable professional certification.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, insurance, dental benefits, customer operations, or another regulated service environment.
  • Experience leading vendor onboarding, vendor transitions, sourcing implementations, or vendor-supported operational projects.
  • Experience serving as an Epic Owner, Business Project Manager, Program Manager, Agile Product Manager, or similar business delivery role.
  • Experience coordinating operational readiness across training, communications, procedures, testing, reporting, and business controls.
  • Experience supporting customer experience, digital, payment, communication, or operational transformation initiatives.
  • Advanced degree in Business, Project Management, Operations, or a related discipline.

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life.
